findings.title: Include the organization in the attribute-key cache key
findings.body: The new React Query key contains only the query options, although the fetch function calls an organization-specific endpoint. When switching between organizations with identical filters—for example, all projects and the same relative date range—both organizations share a cache entry. Cached custom attribute names from the previous organization can therefore appear in the next organization, and concurrent observers can reuse the wrong organization's response. Include the organization slug or endpoint path in the key.

findings.title: Normalize error and recording timestamps before merging
findings.body: Error timestamps read from nodestore are Unix seconds, while rrweb recording event timestamps are Unix milliseconds. Comparing these values directly places virtually every error before the first recording event, regardless of when it actually occurred. The generated error messages also retain the seconds value while recording messages use recording timestamps, giving Seer inconsistent timing context. Normalize both sources to the same unit before comparison and message generation, and test with realistic epoch timestamps.

findings.title: Pass actual query results to the new table visualization
findings.body: When an organization has `use-table-widget-visualization`, the dashboard renders the replacement table with empty columns, empty rows, and empty metadata instead of the fetched result. Consequently, every table widget becomes empty for that organization even when its query returned data. Wire the result and configured fields into the new component before enabling this branch, or retain the existing visualization until that integration is ready.

findings.title: Only fall back when a custom renderer returns undefined
findings.body: The custom renderer contract says that returning `undefined` requests fallback rendering, but the implementation uses a truthiness check. Valid React nodes such as `0`, an empty string, or `null` are discarded and replaced with the default cell content. This prevents custom renderers from displaying zero directly or intentionally suppressing a cell. Check `cell !== undefined` in both the body and header renderer wrappers.
